summary: Pre-market risk holds at caution with a total score of 43.5, still in a goldilocks regime of low volatility, positive momentum and healthy breadth. The macro leg is the only stretched dimension at 62.21, with the ten-year real rate at 2.43 (99th percentile) and the ten-year yield at 4.7 (98th percentile). Overnight, July CPI disinflation extended (headline 3.3, core 2.47) and yields eased, while US memory and AI-infrastructure names rallied (Micron 4.92, NVIDIA 3.03); the A-share memory chain instead closed lower (Longsys -4.18, Biwin Storage -4.03). The central tension is hot US AI-infrastructure momentum against a softening labor market (payrolls -23.0), with July PPI due later today.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Macro is the only stretched dimension (score 62.21): the ten-year real rate of 2.43 sits at the 99th percentile and the ten-year yield of 4.7 at the 98th, keeping rates the binding constraint.
The largest single contributor is the cross-asset confirmation proxy at 0.625, adding 7.5 to the total score.
Labor quality is deteriorating beneath the surface: payrolls printed -23.0, participation fell to 61.4 and continuing claims rose to 1801000.
Leadership is narrow: 69.03% of stocks sit above their 200-day average, but the new-highs ratio is only 5.16%.

supporting_signals.claim: Disinflation is back on track: July headline CPI eased to 3.3 from 3.46 and core to 2.47 from 2.57.
Volatility and yields eased overnight: the VIX fell to 15.28 from 15.46, the ten-year yield to 4.7 from 4.72 and the two-year to 4.22 from 4.25.
US AI-infrastructure and memory names rallied overnight: AI Infrastructure +6.34, Memory +5.41, NVIDIA +3.03 and Micron +4.92.

contradicting_signals.claim: Cross-market divergence: the A-share memory chain closed lower (Longsys -4.18, Biwin Storage -4.03) even as US memory rallied overnight (Micron +4.92).
Credit edges wider even as rates fall: the high-yield OAS ticked up to 2.72 from 2.7 and investment-grade to 0.79 from 0.78.
Investors are questioning data-center loan valuations after Nvidia's latest financing move — a caution flag on the AI capex funding chain.

what_changed_today: The total risk score eased 0.12 on the day and 2.81 on the week as July CPI confirmed the disinflation path.
The A-share memory chain closed sharply lower, led by Longsys -4.18 and Biwin Storage -4.03, against a strong US memory session.
A Chinese NAND maker overtook Micron and Kioxia in key NAND chip shipments — the top overnight story (CNBC).
watch_next: July PPI at 12:30 UTC today is the immediate test of the disinflation narrative.
Advance retail sales land tomorrow — a read on consumer health after the weak payrolls print.
Nvidia reports on the 26th; watch how the data-center loan debate shapes AI-capex sentiment.
Iran disputes US claims that the Strait of Hormuz is reopening; shipping remains a live risk channel.

bull_case.title: Bull case: disinflation keeps the goldilocks regime intact
points: Headline CPI at 3.3 and core at 2.47 keep the Fed on hold and support lower yields (ten-year 4.7).
Low volatility (VIX 15.28) and positive momentum (price 9.65 above the 200-day average) underpin the regime.

base_case.title: Base case: caution persists with macro as the binding constraint
points: The macro leg stays stretched (ten-year real rate 2.43 at the 99th percentile) while volatility and credit remain benign.
The top driver, cross-asset confirmation at 0.625, is a proxy carrying a 0.8 discount — treat its 7.5 contribution cautiously.

bear_case.title: Bear case: labor cracks and a stretched macro break the calm
points: Payrolls at -23.0 with participation at 61.4 and continuing claims at 1801000 point to a cooling economy.
If today's PPI shows sticky pipeline prices, a real rate at the 99th percentile leaves little room for error.
